name: Global Extremum Masking
description: Replaced the local bipartite constraint (average is 1.5, i.e., tiers must be different) with a global sum over a rational function. Because the function's minimum over the discrete domain {1, 2} is uniquely achieved when the variables differ, the global equality mathematically forces the local inequality on every edge. This defeats pattern matching on bipartite keywords or simple linear inequalities.
